paragraphs: AI: "The AI bubble is about to burst — and a big market correction is coming" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "AI Trade Reversal Pierces Asia’s Star Picks-and-Shovels Stocks" (Bloomberg.com).

Political: "‘No Kings’ protesters spurn organizers' rules: ‘This is as partisan as you can get’" (Fox News) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Auburn stun No 1 Georgia on last-gasp field goal as top-ranked teams fall in successive weeks" (The Guardian).
Economic: "UK Inflation Can Seal the Deal on the BOE’s November Rate Hike" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Can the Fed Fight Inflation Without Hurting Farmers?" (Bloomberg).

Financial: "Venezuela Sees Nearly $76 Billion Oil Investment Over Five Years" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Australian Home Auctions Decline as Rate Hikes Dampen Activity" (Bloomberg).

Geopolitical: "Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies" (BBC News) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Graham Breaks With Trump Over Russia Sanctions Law Her Brother Championed" (The New York Times).
